title: Trove habit check-in
description: One line of habits/<source>/checkins/YYYY-MM.jsonl: one habit-day record, append-only. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

date.description: the day checked, date-only YYYY-MM-DD (local); the dedupe key (source + habit + date)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

habit.description: the habit id this check-in belongs to

status.description: coarse outcome: "done" | "skipped" (deliberately excused — a vacation day) | "missed"; never guessed from a partial value

ts.description: RFC3339 local moment of the check-in, when the source records one

value.description: logged amount for a measurable habit (8 glasses, 30 minutes) — the per-day total

note.description: free-form note attached to the check-in

guid.description: source-native check-in id, where one exists
